prompt: A survey stake extends one side of a triangular lot, forming an exterior angle of $(5x)^\circ$. The two remote interior angles measure $(2x + 10)^\circ$ and $(x + 30)^\circ$. Find $x$.
hint: The exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.

hints.text: The exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.
Write $5x = (2x + 10) + (x + 30)$ and combine like terms on the right.

explanation: Check: the exterior angle is $100^\circ$ and the remote interiors are $50^\circ$ and $50^\circ$, which do add to $100$. ✓

alternativeExplanations.title: Verify the whole triangle
steps: With $x = 20$, the two remote interior angles are $50^\circ$ each, and the third angle is the linear-pair partner of the $100^\circ$ exterior angle: $180 - 100 = 80^\circ$.
$50 + 50 + 80 = 180^\circ$, so the lot closes up correctly.
